title: Shared value types
description: One representation per value, used by every module's schema via $ref.

SchoolDate.description: Civil date at the school, computed in Asia/Kolkata, never in UTC.

Paise.description: Money as an integer count of INR paise. There is no float rupee anywhere in this product.

Marks.description: Marks as a decimal STRING so 8.5 never becomes 8.499999999999999 in JavaScript. At most two decimal places; the per-assessment maximum is enforced by M05.

Version.description: Integer version of a mutable aggregate. Writes send expected_version; a mismatch is 409.

EvidenceRef.description: Pointer to one immutable private object. Carries no URL: a URL is minted per request after an Access check, so a leaked ref grants nothing.

ResourceGrant.description: SERVER-INTERNAL. Never accepted from a browser and never present in a request body; the shared middleware refuses any payload containing it.
